scope: ATS/IDSA 2019 CAP guideline criteria that define severe pneumonia, carried forward from the 2007 IDSA/ATS rule.

keyRecommendations.text: Severe CAP is one major criterion or three or more minor criteria.
Major criteria are septic shock needing vasopressors and respiratory failure needing mechanical ventilation.

Minor criteria include respiratory rate at least 30, PaO2/FiO2 ratio 250 or less, multilobar infiltrates, confusion, uraemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, hypothermia, and hypotension needing aggressive fluid resuscitation.

clinicalBottomLine: Use the major and minor criteria to recognise severe CAP. One major criterion, or three minor criteria, defines severe disease in this guideline.
notableCaveats: The CAPE COD steroid trial is not an open full text and is not used. These questions are about severity criteria, not adjunct steroids.

source.title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Adults with Community-acquired Pneumonia. An Official Clinical Practice Guideline of the American Thoracic Society and Infectious Diseases Society of America.
